data.body: [non-codebase] evidence for 'Gerrit Verified +1: every CI job logs uv 0.13.6': Gerrit change 3130 (https://rebar.solutions.navateam.com/c/rebar/+/3130) revision 92ed6fb55b3d364b82de0cdbd4f2bf5497d4f231 received Verified+1 at 2026-10-28 20:02 PDT ('SUCCESS: https://github.com/navapbc/rebar/actions/runs/40807167861') and LLM-Review+1, and merged 2026-10-28 20:03:32 PDT.
